correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction from the cube-edge intersection graph gives 32 perfect matchings and complete face-cardinality vector (1,24,192,520,468,192,32). Reconstructed the deterministic greedy Morse matching: 692 nonempty matching pairs, critical one vertex and 43 two-simplices, with complete DAG topological sort of all 1428 nonempty faces. Forman discrete Morse theory gives a CW complex having only one 0-cell and 43 2-cells, which must be a wedge of 43 2-spheres integrally. This proves homotopy, stronger than mod-two boundary ranks alone.
